title: Wedding Invitation Templates: 5 Styles, 15 Editable PPTX Designs, Details & RSVP, Print and Mobile
description:
Choose a wedding style and make it your own. This collection pairs invitations, details cards and RSVP cards in five coordinated looks: Minimal, Woodland, Glamour, Vintage and Urban.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
15 original layouts: three cards in each of five styles. Matching mobile adaptations of those same 15 layouts are included.
Download five ZIPs directly from Etsy, one per style. Together they contain:
• 10 editable PPTX files, three pages each: five Print and five Mobile.
• 10 static sample PDFs, three pages each.
• 30 sample JPGs: 15 print and 15 mobile.
• 11 original URW font files with their license notice, plus an editing guide in every ZIP.

PERSONALIZE YOUR DETAILS
Install the included fonts, then edit a working copy of your chosen PPTX on a desktop computer. Replace all example names, initials, dates, venues, addresses, schedules, dress codes and response contacts. Text fields are editable; decorative botanical images and the Glamour ornament are fixed raster artwork. Longer names or extra wording may need a smaller font or manual line adjustment. Print and mobile files are edited separately.

SIZES & COMPATIBILITY
Print cards: 5 x 7 inches, portrait. Sample print JPGs: 1500 x 2100 pixels at 300 ppi at that size. Mobile sample JPGs: 1080 x 1920 pixels, 9:16.
PPTX import and PDF export were tested in LibreOffice. Native Microsoft PowerPoint, Keynote and Canva were not tested; font rendering and spacing can vary between applications. This is a PPTX collection, not a Canva template. No Canva link or app subscription is included.

HOW TO USE
1. Download all five ZIPs from your Etsy purchases and unzip them.
2. Install the included fonts and open a working copy of a Print or Mobile PPTX.
3. Replace every example detail and proofread all three pages.
4. Export a personalized PDF for printing or a mobile JPG for messaging.
The included PDF/JPG files are filled examples, not editable forms. RSVP cards do not collect responses automatically: replace the website placeholder with your own real website, email or phone number. Delete the sample guest-name and dietary text if you want blank spaces for handwriting.

PRINTING NOTES
Finished-size single cards; no bleed, crop marks or imposed multi-card sheets. Print at 100%/Actual Size and test a copy before ordering a batch. Dark backgrounds use substantial ink. Champagne/gold details are color effects, not real foil or metallic ink. Embedded artwork retains its original resolution; this collection is not advertised as native 4K art.

LICENSE & IMPORTANT DETAILS
Personal use for one private wedding celebration. Share your personalized final invitations with your guests; a print shop may print your finished PDFs. Do not resell, redistribute or publicly share the templates, original ZIPs or extracted illustrations. Commercial client/event-planner use is not included. Font files keep their own supplied license terms.
Digital files only: no printed stationery, envelopes, props, printing, customization service, QR codes, hosting or RSVP tracking. Buyer files have no promotional watermarks. Cover staging is illustrative; the style galleries and full-set overview show the actual exported pages.
The Woodland and Vintage botanicals and Glamour decorative border were created with AI assistance and incorporated into these original stationery layouts.

Please contact Pinogri through Etsy if you need help accessing the files.
